description: This file contains unit tests for the License model within the Goteo project, verifying object instantiation, validation, creation, deletion, and retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: LicenseTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the License model, testing creation, validation, deletion, and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the License object and disables cache during the test.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Ensures the License object validates correctly and cannot be saved if invalid.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Creates a new License object with test data, validates, saves, retrieves, compares data, and tests deletion.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Tests retrieving and deleting a non-existing License record, expecting failure.
